source.author: @N01ennn
source.text: 20 GitHub repos for agent-driven motion design / video generation with Opus 5.5: skills, render engines (HyperFrames, Remotion, GSAP), and taste/principles. Stack: Opus writes the code, a skill sets timing and camera, an engine renders the MP4.

items.title: claude-motion
items.description: Motion skill with taste; checks its own frames, writes sound in code. Built for Opus 5.5.

items.title: claude-motion-design
items.description: Motion design via HTML, Playwright and ffmpeg — no Remotion.

items.title: motion-graphics-skills
items.description: 13 skills for making launch videos.

items.title: claude-remotion-skill
items.description: A Remotion editor from one prompt: captions, B-roll, sound.

items.title: klik-anim-skill-creation
items.description: Skill encoding the laws of animation and camera movement.

items.title: hyperframes-motion-reel-skill
items.description: Showreel cut to the beat at 120 BPM, built on HyperFrames.

items.title: product-launch-motion
items.description: Full product launch film: voice-over, camera, color grade.

items.title: animate
items.description: Short clip in a single canvas file, storyboarded as it goes.

items.title: motion-design-skills
items.description: Skills for timing, color, typography, logos; Remotion-based.

items.title: hyperframes-student-kit
items.description: 14 skills and 406 motion graphics reference cards for HyperFrames.

items.title: HyperFrames
items.description: Render engine: HTML to MP4. The most commonly installed engine for these skills.

items.title: Remotion
items.description: Render engine: programmatic video written in React.

items.title: Remotion skills (official)
items.description: Official Remotion agent skills.

items.title: GSAP
items.description: JavaScript animation timelines; what HyperFrames runs on. Skills: npx skills add greensock/gsap-skills

items.title: motion-design-skill (LottieFiles)
items.description: Engine-agnostic motion principles skill.

items.title: awesome-motion-design-agent-skills
items.description: Curated map of GSAP, Remotion, Lottie and Rive agent skills.

items.title: motion-graphics
items.description: Generates B-roll straight from a transcript.

items.title: motion-dev-animations-skill
items.description: Web UI animation with Motion.dev (not video).

items.title: Motion (formerly Framer Motion)
items.description: Web animation library for React/JS.

items.title: lottie-web
items.description: Render Lottie animations on the web — for when you need Lottie, not MP4.
